title: Implement Queue Using Arrays
problemStatement: Implement a queue using a fixed-size array. The queue should support the following operations: enqueue(x) — Insert an element at the rear. dequeue() — Remove and return the front element. front() — Return the front element without removing it. isEmpty() — Return whether the queue is empty. Process a sequence of operations and print the result of every dequeue(), front(), and isEmpty() operation.
input: Integer capacity Integer q Next q lines each contain one operation.
output: Print the output for every dequeue(), front(), and isEmpty() operation.
